```{=html}
<div class="contact-grid">
  <div>
    <p class="eyebrow">Start here</p>
    <h2>Tell us what you're <em>working with.</em></h2>
    <p class="lede">A few lines is plenty. You'll come away with a clear sense of what's possible and roughly what it would take, whether or not we end up working together.</p>
    <ol class="checklist">
      <li><div><strong>The systems you use today</strong>POS, CRM, accounting, spreadsheets, an existing website, whatever's in the mix.</div></li>
      <li><div><strong>What you want to see, fix, or automate</strong>The question you can't answer, or the task that eats your week.</div></li>
      <li><div><strong>Your timeline</strong>A hard deadline, or just "sooner is better."</div></li>
    </ol>
  </div>

  <div class="contact-card">
    <p class="eyebrow">Email</p>
    <a class="email" href="mailto:info@dominicschenone.com">info@dominicschenone.com</a>

    <hr>
```
